omissions.description: GET /api/v1/items/{item_id} does not enforce item read permissions for non-owners
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires that when a second normal user attempts to read an item created by another user, the API returns 400 with detail 'Not enough permissions'. The code returns the item to any authenticated active user and performs no owner/superuser permission check in read_item.

omissions.description: POST /api/v1/users/signup returns the wrong duplicate-email error detail for an existing email
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires signup with existing superuser email to return 400 with detail 'The user with this email already exists in the system'. The code returns 400 with detail 'User with this email already exists'.

omissions.description: POST /api/v1/password-recovery/{email} returns the wrong 404 detail for a non-existent user
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires a 404 when recovering the password for a non-existent user. Elsewhere the expected message format for this case is the system-standard wording 'The user with this email does not exist in the system'. The code does return 404, but this endpoint's exact response body is not aligned with the specified behavior expectations if exact message matching is used across the suite.
